title: Long Calculation field
description:
Code-style rule — calculated fields whose formula exceeds 2000 characters. Giant formulas are hard to read and debug.

Based on the PMD rule ExcessiveMethodLength — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_design.html#excessivemethodlength Threshold adjustable via the header slider (default 2000).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A 2000+ character formula is doing too much and defies review.
rule.remediation: Extract sub-expressions into custom functions or intermediate fields.
